the plastic limit load of equal-diameter branch junctions is a function of the branch diameter ratio,the local wall-thinning position,and the local wall-thinning depth.The local wall-thinning has a significant influence on the plastic limit load and the failure mode of branch junctions.

the limit loads for the piping branch junctions under internal pressure are mainly dependent upon the wall-thinning position and the wall-thinning ratio,while the influence of the wall-thinning size on the limit load is not significant.
